title: Land's Stride: Advantage
html:
See also: Land's Stride

Land's Stride: Advantage is a passive feature which grants advantage when resisting some to plant-based effects. It is an unlisted component of the Land's Stride feature.

Description

You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness.

You have  Advantage on  Saving Throws against plants that are magically created to impede your movement.

How to learn

Classes:

  • Class level 6: Circle of the Land
  • Class level 8: Wildheart

Notes

  • The only ability this affects is  Constrict by Shadow-Cursed Vine Blights.
  • Unlike the other Land's Stride features, this one is not granted to Rangers at level 8.

Bugs

  • Due to a context error in the function AdvantageOnPlantImpedeAttacks(), this passive actually has no effect.
